program: Guest posts + expert quotes — authority (dofollow, in-content, real indexed sites)
goal: One earned dofollow in-content link per site per week from real, indexed, relevant EU sites. Directories/Web-2.0 are done — they do not move authority.

rules.no_names: No rights-holder, channel, league, club, broadcaster or streaming-service names. Never 'X% legal'.
rules.anchor: Brand name or naked URL only. Exactly ONE contextual link per piece, pointing to a GUIDE page (never the money page).
rules.author: PUBLISHER / BYLINE in all content = the linked site's own brand name (IPTVESP, RodakTV, IPTV Segura, PrimeIPTV France, IPTVPIX, IPTVNED, IPTV Shqiptar, Smarters Pro France, IPTV France Officiel). NEVER write 'oughia' or 'alghostrader' in any pitch, draft, byline or quote. (The git commit author stays alghostrader — that is technical only, never shown to editors/readers.)
rules.excluded_reason: spam-score review open — hold out of authority outreach until owner clears (both were resumed on the dashboard 2026-09-08; confirm before including).
rules.owner_gated: Owner sends every pitch and creates every account/login. Claude only prepares packages.
rules.on_live: Tick the link on https://iptv.alghostrader.com/links and paste the URL; log in OUTREACH-LOG.csv.
